name: k-fin-agent-suite
description: Codex skills for the k-fin Claude-style agent review commands.

interface.shortDescription: Run k-fin review and plan agents from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Adds Codex-native adapters for the k-fin Claude Code commands while reusing the repo's existing Markdown agent definitions. Review skills are read-only; the suite-level Write capability exists for plan-status, which may edit only the canonical plan according to its source agent rules.
